title: Result Field Composition Explorer
description: Interactive p5.js MicroSim for composing an xAPI result object field-by-field with live JSON output and a 2x2 completion-by-success state grid.
creator: xAPI Course Project
subject: xAPI

chapter_title: Advanced Statement Structure - Voiding, Sub-Statements, Extensions, and Attachments
learningObjectives: Compose a valid xAPI result object by selecting values for each sub-field.
Distinguish completion from success and articulate why the two fields are independent.
Compute a scaled score from raw, min, and max values.
Read and write ISO 8601 duration strings.

prerequisites: Familiarity with the actor / verb / object structure of an xAPI statement

pedagogical.instructionalPattern: Parameter exploration with live JSON feedback
pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a learner scenario, the student selects appropriate values for each result sub-field and sees the rendered JSON update in real time, reinforcing the orthogonality of completion and success.
assessmentOpportunities: Predict the rendered JSON before adjusting a slider
Identify which preset matches a written learner scenario
Justify why completion and success are independent
